models.notes: About 321B parameters, 288 routed experts plus 1 shared, 8 per token, 45 layers (3 dense), gated delta (KDA) and sparse attention, FP8 weights with F32 128x128 block scales. Streams on one H200 with wsp/giant.py.

models.notes: About 2.8T parameters, 896 routed experts, 16 per token, 93 layers, latent MoE (experts run at width 3584), block attention residuals. Experts are compressed-tensors mxfp4. The remote code imports names that transformers 5.23.0 does not have, so it needs 4.57.x. Streams with wsp/giant.py on the 4.57.1 image; not run.

stream.stored: mxfp4 experts (uint8 pairs, uint8 e8m0 scale per 32), bf16 rest
stream.note: Remote code forces flash_attention_2; the profile run uses sdpa. fla-core and einops needed.

models.notes: Released 2026-11-02. Same shapes as Kimi-K3 plus a DSA indexer in the 24 full-attention layers. The repo has configuration code (auto_map has only AutoConfig) and no modeling file, and transformers 5.23.0 has no kimi_k31 class, so a layer cannot be built yet. Expert tensors use the K3 names.

stream.note: No modeling code for the indexer layers.

models.notes: The open Qwen3.8-Max base: 2.4T parameters, 95B active, 512 routed experts plus 1 shared, 10 per token, gated delta and gated attention layers. 512 routed experts plus 1 shared, 10 per token, BF16, experts fused per layer, 807 GB in 94 files, with a vision tower.
